label: Glory events fill the arenas instead of sporting events
description: Youth seen filling major auditoriums, with the Lord saying that instead of sporting events they are about to see glory events, and a major revival with them. Arena attendance is published, which makes this checkable.

label: Jihad and the Mahdi, used to create instability in America
description: Given 2 October 2025 with a stated urgency: the devil trying to disrupt the coming revival, the words jihad and Mahdi heard repeatedly, and a plan to create instability in America. He says the open-eyed vision about America and Israel lasted almost an hour.
aliases: I kept hearing the word jihad

label: Italy shaken, all Europe shaken, and a mighty revival in Europe
description: Italy and then all Europe shaken, with a great mighty revival in Europe following, given alongside the recollection that he had said a major revival would take place in the Vatican. Shaken is left between physical and figurative.
aliases: revival will take place in Europe
